current_protocol.primary_order: train | valid | public | small gap | private
current_protocol.rule: Future primary fits, normalizers, teachers, initializers, and preprocessing use only the official earlier train file; evaluate on the complete later official valid file with whole sequences.
current_protocol.chronology_limit: The adopted Predictorium protocol is a project decision, not independent proof of current Connectome timestamps. Do not infer chronology from seq_ix or Parquet row order.
current_protocol.historical_handling: Keep older recipes and scores unchanged, label their protocol, and do not treat historical F0 evidence as chronological confirmation.

full_gru_tweaks_r1.status: Completed five-child F0/seed-1001 scoring panel. Six scientific model fits were recorded: one shared parent plus five child fits. Five separate prerequisites were counted separately: three teachers, propensity, and dictionary. The parent is an initializer, not one of the five scored endpoints.

parent_recipe.architecture: Freshly initialized H256x2 GRU, linear encoder, 211 inputs, 23 outputs.
parent_recipe.training: Seed 1001; B16/C2000; strict FP32; AdamW lr=1e-4, wd=.01; fixed T3 teacher target; four epochs, fixed zero-based epoch 3; no evaluation during fit.
parent_recipe.role: Every scored child initialized from this same accepted parent checkpoint at epoch 3 and inherited its preprocessing/normalization.

child_common_recipe.architecture: GRU, hidden 256, two layers, linear encoder, one-layer readout, dropout 0. Parent 211-input/23-output function was zero-extended to the common 467-input/25-output child layout.
child_common_recipe.feature_layout: 211-prefix = raw 112 plus canonical event 99; append 128 dictionary and 128 history slots. Inactive slots are exact zeros. The two appended outputs are logvariance rows; WMSE arms skip their variance contribution.
child_common_recipe.training: Seed 1001; seeded sample order; train-source train+valid with valid-fold 0; 10,535 train sequences plus all 1,405 fit-valid sequences; full 20,000-row sequences; B16/C2000; six epochs, fixed epoch 5; AdamW lr=1e-4, wd=.01, beta2=.999; OneCycle warmup .05; global clip 1; strict FP32; no evaluation during fit; resumable state and gradient statistics saved.
child_common_recipe.observed_endpoint: Each child completed 44,760 successful updates over 4,476 batches with zero skipped/nonfinite updates, selected fixed epoch 5, and was accepted. No quality score was emitted by the fit itself.

target_and_objectives.main_weights: abs(clip(label,-2,2)) multiplied by canonical main_valid; common denominator across arms.
target_and_objectives.auxiliary_losses: Structural and next-step auxiliary weights .3 each; distillation family weight 0.
target_and_objectives.wmse: sum(w*(mu-target)^2)/sum(w), with the common chunk-normalized WMSE compatibility setting.
target_and_objectives.nll: sum(w*(exp(-s)*(mu-target)^2+s))/sum(w), with s=logvariance clamped to [-4,4]. The NLL arms use the same teacher/label target and weights.

arms.name: EMA
arms.representation: causal signed input-history EMA, half-life 32; WMSE; not parameter EMA/SWA

arms.name: Sparse
arms.representation: learned 112-to-16 dictionary; stable signed top-4 code plus 112 normalized raw residual features; WMSE

arms.name: AllThree
arms.representation: EMA history + sparse dictionary/residual + coupled NLL

prerequisite_ancestry.teachers: Three H384x2 GRU teachers, seeds 3/4/5, linear encoder, output 23, batch 32/chunk 1000, three epochs/fixed epoch 2, strict FP32 Muon-all, lr=.001, wd=.01, OneCycle warmup .05, WMSE plus .3 structural/.3 next-step auxiliaries. Their actual argv uses train+valid and valid-fold 0; each has a source-bound accepted terminal receipt. The homogeneous cache supplies the blended target.
prerequisite_ancestry.propensity: Separate accepted 64-hidden, four-epoch, seed-0 strict-FP32 scoring-mask prerequisite; 3,520 updates; its receipt calls it train-only and makes no quality claim.
prerequisite_ancestry.dictionary: Separate accepted train-only representation prerequisite: 64 fit components, 31,808 sampled rows, 112 input features, 16-dimensional encoder, 112-dimensional decoder, signed top-k 4, 12 epochs, CPU FP32 AdamW lr=.001/wd=.0001, 756 updates. Fit-row normalization used FP64 CPU population moments then stored/applied FP32.
prerequisite_ancestry.normalization: Child normalization is inherited from the parent and identified by hashes. The report says it was computed from the parent's first two B16 fitting batches, not refit on all sequences.
prerequisite_ancestry.ancestry_assessment: Teacher and child command receipts explicitly use train+valid with internal valid-fold 0; child membership receipt is fit_train=10,535, fit_valid=1,405, evaluation=468. The shared parent is the full F0 fit and its children inherit that state. This is not official-train-only ancestry under the current policy. It is historical F0 component-heldout evidence; the 468 eval groups were fit-excluded, but the fit used the valid source and the F0 panel does not establish chronological order.

evaluation.scope: Only the 468 fit-excluded, repeatedly exposed F0 development groups; 141 components; metric global_wp_clip2_v1; official row mask is is_scored AND (t >= 99); 808,863 selected rows per arm.
evaluation.full_official_valid: No. The scored panel is the 468-member F0 development panel, not the complete official valid file.
evaluation.public: No public endpoint or public score is reported.
evaluation.uncertainty: 2,000 paired component-bootstrap replicates, seed 271828, conditional on the five fixed epoch-5 predictions. CIs are unadjusted across the four candidate/control contrasts and do not estimate fit-seed, endpoint-selection, or public-transfer uncertainty.
evaluation.source_strength: The scalar table and contrasts come from the captured original RESULT.json. The first-cell report records root acceptance and fit/score lifecycle closure. No metric was independently recomputed for this audit.

interpretation.confirmed: All five fixed child endpoints were actually scored. AllThree is the highest observed WP in this one panel; its unadjusted conditional component interval is above zero. EMA and Sparse intervals include zero; NLL's interval also includes zero.
interpretation.limits: One fitting seed, one shared parent, one exposed legacy F0 panel, four unadjusted contrasts, and no full factorial. AllThree does not identify synergy or isolate which ingredient helped. The bootstrap does not replace replication or chronological primary validation.
interpretation.next_use: Treat AllThree and NLL as hypotheses for prospective screening, not confirmed gains. EMA-only and Sparse-only were approximately flat in this recipe/panel. None of these scores forecasts public transfer.

recipe.architecture: Cold-start H512x1 GRU, encoder/recurrent/readout width 512, one head layer, dropout 0; 367 equal-width inputs.
recipe.training: Seed 1001; train-source train+valid, internal valid-fold 0; B8/C2000; three epochs, fixed epoch 2; AdamW, lr=.001, wd=.01, beta2=.999, OneCycle warmup .05, clip 1, strict FP32, WMSE chunk normalization; 4,620 expected updates per arm.
recipe.sample: 10% F0 component subset: 315 components; 1,118 train + 118 valid fitting sequences; complete 468-sequence F0 evaluation; 20,000 rows per sequence.
recipe.feature_processing: Fit-only RMS within-sequence first-difference scale, floor 1e-4. Apply masks after common preprocessing/normalization.
